title: Toen ik klein was…
summary: Childhood and school vocab, and toen as a conjunction that sends the verb to the end

blocks.title: Toen ik klein was…
blocks.body: To tell a childhood story you need one little word: **toen** (when, back then). As a conjunction it opens a subclause — and like every Dutch subclause, the **verb jumps to the end**: *Toen ik klein **was**…* Then the main clause starts with its verb (inversion): *Toen ik klein was, **woonde** ik in Utrecht.*
blocks.callout: Two verbs, two ends: *…was,* then *woonde…* — the comma is the hinge.

blocks.title: Toen ≠ als ≠ wanneer
blocks.body: Three words all become 'when' in English, but Dutch splits them. **toen** = one moment or period in the **past** (*toen ik klein was*). **als** = something **repeated** or in the future (*als het regent*). **wanneer** = the **question** word (*wanneer kom je?*). For childhood memories it's almost always **toen**.

options: Toen ik klein was, ik woonde in Breda.
Toen ik was klein, woonde ik in Breda.
Toen ik klein was, woonde ik in Breda.
blocks.explain: The subclause sends its verb to the end (*…klein **was***); then the main clause inverts to verb-first (*…**woonde** ik…*). Only the third line does both.

pairs.left: Toen ik klein was… — When I was little… (once, past)
pairs.right: Als ik ziek was… — Whenever I was ill… (repeated)
pairs.note: Both are past, but *toen* marks one period and *als* marks every time it happened. English blurs them; Dutch keeps them apart.

blocks.title: Bouw een jeugdherinnering
blocks.prompt: Build a 'when I was little' sentence: verb last in the toen-clause, then invert.
blocks.sample: Toen ik klein was, speelde ik altijd buiten.

blocks.prompt: Say 'When I was little, I lived in Amsterdam.' (mind the word order)
answers: toen ik klein was, woonde ik in amsterdam
toen ik klein was woonde ik in amsterdam
blocks.hint: …was at the end of the first part, then *woonde ik*.
blocks.explain: *Toen ik klein was, woonde ik in Amsterdam.* Verb-final in the subclause, inversion in the main clause.

lines.target: Toen ik klein was, woonde ik in een dorp.
lines.en: When I was little, I lived in a village.

lines.target: Ik ging elke dag met de fiets naar school.
lines.en: I went to school by bike every day.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.
Write two lines that start with *Toen ik klein was,* — where you lived and one thing you did. Watch the verb positions.
